by: Kar (Claude Opus 5.5), the builder, simulating four buyers
how: The served page (HTTP 200, byte-identical to index.html at 348f5ef apart from line endings) read cold from the top as each buyer in turn, every section, button and number, listing what it left a buyer unable to answer. Each gap was then answered on the page from the repository's own code, records and sourced figures, or is listed as open.

gaps.gap: The cost section's typing speed, working weeks and typist count were typed into the page script, and nothing beside the result said where each came from.
gaps.answered: For your business, The time it gives back: computed by src/timecase.mjs from vendor/basis/basis.json and data/typing-basis.json, every figure listed with its source under the result (claims-timecase.json T1).

gaps.gap: With no hourly cost entered, the case gave hours but no money figure.
gaps.answered: The same section: a blank hourly cost is valued at the UK median hourly wage (ONS ASHE 2025, on-costs left out), and the result says so.

gaps.gap: No figure over a budget period.
gaps.answered: The same section: years to count, each later year rising by UK CPI.

gaps.gap: Does pasting a passport add to the AI bill?
gaps.answered: The same section, the note under the sources: input text on a per-token AI, nothing extra on a chat subscription, tiers when length matters.

gaps.gap: The page said the passports were made today, which stopped being true the next day.
gaps.answered: Start here, Status, and Try it: the date is read from the passport's own header.

gaps.gap: The blueprint named the files but not whether each one is gated.
gaps.answered: Blueprint, Gate status organ by organ: each organ's mutants caught and its gate, read from the receipts.

gaps.gap: Third-party code and the supply chain were not addressed.
What happens when a signing key is lost or exposed?
gaps.answered: Security questions, What if a signing key is lost or exposed?

gaps.gap: Does the page itself send anything anywhere?
gaps.answered: Security, No server, no telemetry: only its own files, no other request.

gaps.gap: The diagram's labels were too small to read on a phone.
gaps.answered: How it works: on a narrow screen the diagram keeps a readable size and scrolls sideways.

gaps.gap: Who runs this day to day?
gaps.answered: Deployment and roll-out, week 3 onward: one owner per memory runs the end-of-session command and reviews each hand-back plan.

gaps.gap: How long does one re-brief take, and what is that across a team like ours?
gaps.answered: The time it gives back: minutes per re-brief, and hours a year from your own figures.

gaps.gap: Passport sizes were stated without saying where they came from.
gaps.answered: How you make passports on your own machine, Sizes: read from the records of Kar's passports and the codec's own tier limits.

gaps.gap: Liability and warranty were not stated.
gaps.answered: Supplier, support and ownership: as is under MIT; warranty and liability agreed per deployment.

gaps.gap: The licences of the parts inside, including SYMB-FER's Echo Clause, were not set out.
gaps.answered: Supplier, support and ownership, What is inside, and its licences.

gaps.gap: Whether the supplier receives our data.
gaps.answered: Supplier, support and ownership, Your data.

gaps.gap: No record that buyers had reviewed the page.
gaps.answered: For your business, Buyer walkthroughs: these records, marked as simulations.

open: A live run against Grok waits on an xAI API key being set on Kar's machine; the public slice is built for it and has been booted on a local model instead.
